cargo_profile:
# Repository-wide profiles, including independent developer tools and bindings.
# Run Cargo from within this repository so its hierarchical config is loaded.
# Keep every profile unstripped: Rust 1.97.1 stripping can corrupt Mach-O
# LINKEDIT string pools, rejected by macOS 27 (rust-lang/rust#157750).

[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1
debug = 0
strip = "none"
codegen-units = 256
lto = "off"
incremental = true
panic = "unwind"
debug-assertions = true
overflow-checks = true
rpath = false

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
debug = false
strip = "none"
codegen-units = 1
lto = "thin"
incremental = false
panic = "unwind"
debug-assertions = false
overflow-checks = false
rpath = false

[profile.test]

strip = "none"

debug-assertions = true
overflow-checks = true
rpath = false
